title: Morning Prayer For Provision | Give Us This Day Our Daily Bread (God Is Your Provider)
description:
A morning prayer for provision, built on one line of the Lord's Prayer: Give us this day our daily bread.

If the bills had you doing math before your feet hit the floor, start here. God feeds the birds and He knows what you need. He gave Israel manna one day at a time, kept a widow's barrel from running out, and did not spare His own Son. Ten minutes of Scripture, then a prayer to trust Him for today.

"Give us this day our daily bread." Matthew 6:11 (KJV)

Scriptures in this video (KJV): Matthew 6:9-11, Matthew 6:26, 1 Peter 5:7, Deuteronomy 8:17-18, Acts 17:25, Psalm 104:14, Exodus 16:4, Matthew 6:34, Luke 12:20, 1 Timothy 6:17, 1 Kings 17:14, Psalm 37:25, Genesis 22:8, Romans 8:32, John 6:35, Psalm 68:19.

Type amen in the comments, and send this to a friend who needs it. Subscribe to Blessed Prayers for more.
